identity_marker: matte black Peloton Bike+ with a large rectangular rotating touchscreen monitor and red accents
continuity_anchors: in a brightly lit modern home gym with hardwood floors and soft natural window light
video_goal: Demonstrate the physical and software setup process for joining a live cycling class on a Peloton Bike+.
single_prompt: A close-up shot focuses on the top edge of the matte black Peloton Bike+ with a large rectangular rotating touchscreen monitor and red accents, where a human hand reaches behind the monitor and firmly presses the physical power button. The camera maintains a close-up as the white Peloton logo brightly illuminates in the center of the black touchscreen during boot-up. Transitioning to an over-the-shoulder view, two hands grip the left and right edges of the monitor and physically swivel the rotating screen 180 degrees until it directly faces the bike saddle. In a first-person view, an index finger taps a circular user profile picture on the illuminated touchscreen interface. Pushing in for a direct screen capture angle, a finger swipes up on the glass to scroll, then taps the 'Schedule' calendar icon located on the bottom navigation bar. Shifting to a tight close-up, the finger taps a red 'Count Me In' button located next to a listed Live Cycling Class. The camera pulls back into a first-person view as a hand reaches down to the center frame of the bike and twists the circular red resistance knob clockwise. Arcing to a side angle, a hand pulls up the black lever under the handlebars, slides the handlebar assembly slightly forward, and pushes the lever back down to lock it. Dropping to a low angle close-up, a foot wearing a black cycling shoe with a red Delta cleat hovers directly over the right metal pedal, then presses down forcefully, snapping the red cleat into the pedal mechanism with a visible interlocking movement. Rising to an over-the-shoulder view, the touchscreen displays a live class waiting room with a digital countdown timer ticking down from 00:15 in the center. Finally, from a first-person view, an index finger taps the pulsing 'Join Class' button on the screen, instantly replacing the timer with a live video feed of the cycling instructor, all taking place in a brightly lit modern home gym with hardwood floors and soft natural window light.
